node.statement: By the registered abs-and-sgn-functional-calculus and holomorphic-power-series-functional-calculus definitions, write (U^2)^(-1/2)=sum_{k>=0} a_k(U^2-x_0^2 I)^k using the fixed scalar power series, whenever the construction is defined. For every partial sum p_N, unitality and multiplicativity from node 1.5.3.1 give Phi_n(p_N(U^2))=p_N(Phi_n(U)^2). Since the series converges in norm at both registered instances and Phi_n is bounded, passage to the limit yields Phi_n((U^2)^(-1/2))=(Phi_n(U)^2)^(-1/2). Hence Phi_n(sgn(U))=sgn(Phi_n(U)), and the registered formula theta(U)=(I+sgn(U))/2 gives Phi_n(theta(U))=theta(Phi_n(U)).
